limitations: Acceptance covers the recorded generated and saved material workflows, not every material expression class or rendering platform.
Materials only; material functions and instances are refused.

Cleanup preserves existing node positions. Placement uses conservative node envelopes, can produce backward wires, and refuses when a usage cannot fit inside its block. Full graph organization belongs to Material Tidy.
Labels are proposed for values read by multiple comment blocks; this is not general material graph authoring.
Edit replans from current state; there is no persisted preview approval token. In-process connection/layout changes invalidate the plan.
Failed edits attempt undo and report expression-identity checks only; links, values and external callback effects are not fully verified after rollback.
Compilation and editor callbacks occur on nonempty edits; no save is performed.
Editor screenshot preview panels can lag shader compilation. Independent offscreen renders, not the black editor preview panel, establish the recorded color preservation.
